spec2def(credui.dll credui.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# credui.dll is all Rust (credui-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/credui-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# credui_main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/credui-rust/src/credui/credui_main.rs)
add_cargo_module(credui credui-cargo credui.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE credui-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle
